requirement.description: The port property incorrectly treats port 0 as falsy and falls back to default port instead of returning the explicitly set port 0.
requirement.contract: The port property should return the explicit_port value when it is not None, regardless of whether it's 0 or not. Currently, it uses `self.explicit_port or self._default_port` which treats 0 as falsy.

requirement.description: The explicit_port caching mechanism doesn't properly handle port 0 cases during URL parsing.
requirement.contract: The URL parsing should correctly store port 0 as explicit_port in the cache when explicitly provided in the URL.

requirement.description: Relative URLs are not properly populating the cache, causing KeyError when accessing cached properties like raw_path.
requirement.contract: Relative URLs should populate all necessary cache entries during initialization to prevent KeyError when accessing cached properties.

requirement.description: URL path normalization is not properly handling encoded characters in suffix operations.
requirement.contract: The with_suffix method should properly encode/decode path segments to maintain consistent URL encoding.

requirement.description: URL parsing and cache initialization is incomplete for certain edge cases involving fragment/query combinations.
requirement.contract: All URL parsing should properly initialize cache entries for all relevant properties, including those with fragment/query combinations.
